why: The week label is Trees, but no tree is needed. Values 1..k fill a contiguous block exactly when their positions span k cells, i.e. max(pos) - min(pos) + 1 == k. Grow k from 1 to n while keeping a running min and max of pos[k].
hints: Because p is a permutation, a window of length k that contains 1..k contains nothing else.
Store pos[v] for each value. Values 1..k form a subarray iff the gap between the leftmost and rightmost of their positions is exactly k-1.
Sweep k = 1..n updating lo = min(lo, pos[k]) and hi = max(hi, pos[k]), and emit '1' when hi - lo + 1 == k. O(n).
pitfalls: Check the span, not whether p[0..k-1] is a prefix. [3,1,2,4] has k = 2 balanced at positions 1..2.
k = 1 and k = n are always balanced.
